integrity: All universal conclusions use the analytical proof; numerical checks are finite supporting evidence only. Earlier observations and conjectures are credited; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only local Schur and multiplier stability; no nonlinear flip direction, supercriticality, or global dynamics. Equal age-dependent fecundity and equal survival; survival endpoint p=1 excluded. Qualitative flip expectation was previously asserted numerically, and unknown stronger general Schur criteria remain a priority risk.
title: Exact Schur stability for odd-age geometric Leslie spectra
